# Symbol fixtures

Two screw symbols as OpenSCAD rendered them before round 40 rebuilt the symbol files as lines and arcs, kept as test
input for `dev-notes/tools/arcSymbols.py` (`tests/test_arc_symbols_tool.py`):

- `torx_countersunk_original.svg` = `cullenectIcons/screws/screw_countersunk_machine_full_torx_noflange_nosec.svg`
- `pan_torx_security_original.svg` = `cullenectIcons/screws/screw_pan_machine_full_torx_flange_sec.svg`

They are drawn from [Cullenect-Labels](https://github.com/CullenJWebb/Cullenect-Labels) by CullenJWebb, MIT License
(license text in `lib/gridfinityUtils/cullenectIcons/LICENSE-Cullenect`, origin in
`lib/gridfinityUtils/cullenectIcons/README.md`).
